_about.kind: Original content written for this project. NOT transcribed from any published book.
_about.note: Pools for the six recurring people a campaign opens with (engine/cast.ts). Like job-content.json these cite no page, because there is no book behind them: they are written in the Cyberpunk RED idiom.
_about.shape: Each archetype supplies names, standing lines (what the player openly knows), and the four dossier fields. Every field is drawn deterministically from the campaign seed, so a character's cast is the same cast forever.
_about.rules: A `standing` line is PUBLIC and goes in the prompt. `wants`, `fear` and `secret` are learned through play and must read as true statements about the person, not as hooks addressed to the player. `breakingPoint` is the line they will not cross whatever is offered; write it as a hard limit, not a preference.

fixer.label: Fixer
standing: Your fixer. Takes their cut off the top and never itemises it.
Your fixer. Answers on the second ring, never the first.
The fixer who has your number, which is not the same as trusting you.
Your fixer. Feeds you work steadily enough that you have stopped asking why.
Your fixer. Was doing this before you could hold a gun and will be after.
The fixer who took you on when nobody else was returning calls.
wants: To be the one Watson calls first, and to stop having to prove it every month.
Out. Enough put aside to buy a licence and a legitimate name to hang it on.
To find out who has been undercutting their rates on the same street.
A crew they can send anywhere without being asked what the job really is.
To pay off the people who fronted them their first year, before those people ask.
To place one client so high up the corporate ladder that the ladder becomes theirs.
fear: That the client list is one bad night from ending up on somebody's screen.
Being the last person to know something. It has almost killed them twice.
That the people who fronted them the first year are keeping a running total.
Getting old on The Street with no one who owes them anything.
That a job they brokered years ago is still walking around looking for them.
Being reduced to what they actually are without the phone in their hand.
secret: They have been quietly selling job outcomes to a corporate analyst for two years.
One of the crews they placed last year never came back, and they knew the odds.
They are into a Tyger Claws bookmaker for more than they can raise.
They took a finder's fee to put you specifically on a job that went wrong.
Their real name is on an NCPD file under a case that was never closed.
They have a second phone, and a second client list that nobody on the first one knows about.
breakingPoint: They will not broker anything that touches a child. There is no fee for it.
They will not give up a client's name, even one they despise. It is the whole business.
They will never work with the fixer who burned them in Kabuki, at any price.
They will not walk into a corporate building. Not once, not for anything.
They will not front you money twice. Once is business, twice is a habit.
They will not lie to you about the pay. Everything else is negotiable.

ripperdoc.label: Ripperdoc
standing: Your ripperdoc. The chair is clean, which is more than most can say.
Your ripperdoc. Talks through the whole procedure whether you want it or not.
The ripper who did your first install and has done every one since.
Your ripperdoc. Cash up front, no questions, no small talk.
Your ripperdoc. Keeps a real waiting room and real hours, which costs them clients.
The ripper you go to because the alternative is a chair behind a noodle bar.
wants: A licence. A real one, with their name on it, hanging where people can see it.
To stop working on people who cannot afford what they are asking for.
One clean year with nobody dying on the table.
The equipment to do the work properly instead of the work they can afford to do.
To get their sibling out of the apartment block they both grew up in.
To publish. Somewhere real. Under their own name, about what chrome does to people.
fear: That the last three installs were from a batch they should have refused.
Losing the hands. Everything they are is in twenty centimetres of forearm.
That someone will connect the clinic to the body found in Northside in March.
Their own chrome. They have not looked at their own scans in two years.
That they have started enjoying the part of the job they should not.
The supplier finding out where the surplus stock has actually been going.
secret: They are treating half the block for free and stealing the stock to do it.
They lost their licence in another city, under another name, for good reason.
They keep tissue samples from every client, and they are not sure why any more.
Trauma Team pays them a retainer for names, and the retainer is most of the rent.
The chair in the back room is not theirs. It belongs to people they cannot refuse.
They have installed something in a client that the client did not consent to.
breakingPoint: They will not install anything in someone who cannot say their own name.
They will not go under a Humanity floor with you. They will refuse and mean it.
They will not treat anyone wearing Maelstrom colours. Not after what they saw.
They will not work on a body they were not introduced to while it was breathing.
They will not lie on a scan, for you or anyone. The numbers are the numbers.
They will not let anyone into the back room. Not once, not for anything.

landlord.label: Landlord
standing: Your landlord. Knows exactly what day it is, every month, without a calendar.
Your landlord. Fixes what breaks eventually, and remembers who complained.
Your landlord. Lives two floors down, which cuts both ways.
Your landlord. Has never once raised their voice and has never once forgotten.
Your landlord, and the closest thing this building has to a government.
Your landlord. Was here before the building changed hands and expects to outlast the next one.
wants: To hold onto the building through whatever is coming for it.
One tenant on this floor who is not a problem waiting to be discovered.
To get the water fixed properly, which means money nobody in the building has.
Their name off the deed and someone else's headache in its place.
To know what you actually do, so they can price the risk of you correctly.
The unit on four emptied without anybody official being involved.
fear: The offer they have already had on the building, and what happens when it is refused twice.
That one of these doors is going to open onto something they cannot un-see.
Being alone in this building when it finally stops being theirs.
The inspection they have been putting off for three years.
That the tenant on four has stopped answering for a reason.
Whoever it is that has started asking around about the tenant list.
secret: They have already signed a preliminary agreement with the buyer.
They have a key to your unit and have used it, once, and put everything back.
The building's registered owner has been dead for a year and they have not filed it.
They are paying protection to a gang and calling it a maintenance fee.
There is a body in the block's utility space and they know exactly whose it is.
They have been quietly forgiving one tenant's rent for eight months, and it is not you.
breakingPoint: They will not evict anyone with a child in the unit. They will eat the loss instead.
They will not open a tenant's door for anyone official. Ever, for any reason.
They will not take a payment they cannot write down somewhere.
They will not let anyone move into unit six. It stays empty and they will not say why.
They will not lie to your face. They will decline to answer, but they will not lie.
They will not let the building go to that buyer, whatever the number is.

friend.label: Friend
standing: The one person who has never asked you what you do for money.
Knows you well enough to tell when you are managing them.
Has been in your corner longer than anyone else who is still breathing.
The friend you call at four in the morning, and have.
Owes you nothing, which is exactly why you trust them.
Has bailed you out twice and brought it up neither time.
wants: To get you out of this line of work before it finishes the job.
One thing of their own that has nothing to do with anybody else's problems.
To be needed by you the way they need you, and to stop noticing the difference.
Enough put by to leave Night City, and someone to leave it with.
To finish the thing they started six years ago and have not mentioned since.
To find out what happened to their brother, and to be told the truth about it.
fear: Getting the call about you. They have rehearsed it.
That they are the reason you have not left, and that this makes them selfish.
Turning into their mother, who is still alive and still in the same chair.
That everyone they keep is temporary and they are the common factor.
Being asked for something they will have to say no to.
The debt they took on last year, which they have told nobody about.
secret: They have been talking to someone about you, and telling the truth.
They took money from your enemy once, years ago, and gave it back too late.
They are sicker than they have said, and have known for months.
They have a family across town that they have never mentioned to you.
They kept the thing you asked them to get rid of, and they still have it.
They were there the night it went wrong, and they left before you saw them.
breakingPoint: They will not lie to your face for you. They will refuse the ask instead.
They will not put their sibling anywhere near any of this. Not once.
They will not carry a weapon for you. They will do almost anything else.
They will not be in the room when it turns violent. They will leave.
They will not help you with anything involving that one name, and will not explain.
They will not go back to the Badlands. Not for you, not for anything.

enemy.label: Enemy
standing: Has not forgotten, has not moved on, and is not in a hurry.
Would step over you in the street. Would also step on you.
Tells the story about you at parties, and the story gets worse every year.
Has been patient about this for a long time, which is the worrying part.
Would rather ruin you slowly than have it be over.
Has never once come at you directly, and never once let it go either.
wants: To take from you the one thing you would actually miss.
An apology, in public, which they will never ask for and never accept.
To be the person you became instead of the person they are.
To be finished with you, and cannot work out how to get there.
Everything you have, item by item, and then to hand it to somebody else.
To make you understand, precisely, what it cost. Understanding is the whole point.
fear: That you genuinely do not think about them at all.
That they have become nothing but this, and there is no version of them without it.
The person they answer to, who is losing patience with the whole business.
Dying before it is settled. That is the only thing that frightens them.
That the story they have been telling about that night is not what happened.
Being alone in a room with someone who knew them before.
secret: They tried to make peace, once, through someone who never passed the message on.
They are working for the same fixer you are, one step removed, and do not know it.
The thing they blame you for was mostly somebody else, and they have suspected for a while.
They are dying, and have about a year, and have told no one.
They have a photograph of you both from before, and they have not thrown it away.
They have already sold information about you, and are waiting to see what it buys.
breakingPoint: They will not touch your family. That was the one rule, and it still holds.
They will not do it in front of witnesses. Whatever it is, it happens quietly.
They will not accept money to stop. Offering insults the entire thing.
They will not be the one who moves first. They need you to.
They will not work with the Tyger Claws, whatever it would buy them.
They will not let anybody else be the one who does it.

old_flame.label: Old flame
standing: Still has your number. Uses it about twice a year, always late.
You do not talk. You are both aware of exactly where the other one lives.
It ended badly and neither of you has ever agreed on why.
Left, came back, and has not explained either trip.
The one you do not mention, and everyone who knows you knows not to ask.
Answers on the first ring, every time, which neither of you has ever discussed.
wants: To know whether you are all right, without having to ask you directly.
To finish the argument you never finished, and to win it.
Their things back. The actual things. It has been years and they still want them.
To be told it was not their fault, by you, out loud.
Out of Night City, and to not have to think about any of this again.
One evening where it is the way it used to be, and then never again.
fear: That you have been fine this whole time.
Running into you somewhere with no way to leave gracefully.
That they will say yes to you again, and know they would.
The person they are with now finding out how often they think about this.
That everything since has been a version of trying to get back to it.
Hearing about you secondhand, from someone who does not know.
secret: They kept paying off a debt of yours for a year after it ended.
They were the one who told your enemy where to find you, and they did not mean it to go that way.
They are in debt to people who have started asking about you by name.
They have been outside your building more than once and not come up.
There is a child, and they have never mentioned it, and the arithmetic works.
They left because of something they found out about you, and never told you what.
breakingPoint: They will not put themselves anywhere near your work. That was why it ended.
They will not be lied to twice about the same thing. Once was survivable.
They will not let you near their family again, whatever the reason.
They will not take your money. It is the one thing they will not do.
They will not start it up again. They will do almost anything except that.
They will not tell you where they are living now. Not ever.
